mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased for one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers a delayed monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both PAYEMS and UNRATE have deteriorated for one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months.
